description:
Convert between TOML 1.0, JSON and YAML, validating the input. TOML dates become RFC 3339 strings in JSON; nulls are dropped when writing TOML (it has no null) and reported; integers beyond 2^53 are kept exact; inf and nan become strings in JSON. Use from=toml,to=toml to validate and normalise a TOML file.

Returns: Text: the converted document. structuredContent { output, warnings[] } where warnings list dropped nulls, large integers and non-finite numbers.
Example input: {"text":"[package]
name = "demo"
version = "0.1.0"

[dependencies]
serde = "1.0"","from":"toml","to":"json","indent":2}
On error, includes hint: TOML output needs an object at the top level; wrap arrays in a key.

detect_dates.description: When writing TOML, turn RFC 3339 date/date-time strings into native TOML dates.

indent.description: Indent for JSON and YAML output.

name: toml_convert
title: TOML / JSON / YAML convert
